_readme: The creator kit: what a person who manages clippers and creators needs to run the creator line on their own computer, with their own accounts. check.py reads this file.

needed.GEMINI_API_KEY: reads the swiped videos and writes the teardown
needed.APIFY_TOKEN: pulls posts and comments for the feeds and research rounds
needed.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: transcribes what is said in a video

helpful.HIGGSFIELD_KEY_SECRET: the other half of the Higgsfield pair
helpful.GDRIVE_SA_KEY: files hand-offs and creator footage to a shared Drive

loop.say: run a research round for <avatar> of <brand>
tear down this video for a creator, brand <brand>

loop.step: Write a picture brief for a creator
loop.say: tear down this static for a creator to shoot
check what came back for brief <number>
on brief <number>, move the hook to the start
send brief <number> to the approval page

rules: Every run uses this computer's own keys and accounts; nothing is billed to anyone else.
Nothing goes live from here. The approval page is the owner's click.
The brand folder is linked in from the brand's own repo; it is never copied into Prizm.
